faq.double_elimination_end: The upper- and lower-bracket winners meet in the final. If the lower-bracket winner wins, they play a second final.
faq.elimination_match: A match follows the configured series plan and may contain several games or sets. It can end early once a player has clinched it.
faq.bracket_seeding: The default bracket separates players by rating seed. Before an organizer starts the tournament, they can swap players between the fixed bracket positions, including those receiving byes. Seed numbers stay tied to the rating order frozen when bracket setup opens. Scheduled starts use the default bracket.
faq.double_elimination_brackets: Undefeated players remain in the upper bracket. After a loss, they continue through the lower bracket for as long as they keep winning.
faq.double_elimination_intro: One loss sends you to the lower bracket. A second loss eliminates you.
faq.single_elimination_end: The winner of the final is the tournament champion.
faq.elimination_third_place: Only when the tournament enables one. Otherwise the semifinal losers finish in the same elimination tier.
faq.single_elimination_intro: Win your match to stay in title contention. A loss ends that path, although a semifinal loser may still play a configured third-place match.
faq.double_swiss_scores: The tournament ranks players by game points or by points from each two-game match. The other score can be selected as a tiebreak. The scoring mode and tiebreak order are shown in the tournament details.
faq.double_swiss_intro: Each round pairs you with one opponent for two games instead of one.
faq.swiss_knockout: No. A loss changes your score and future pairings, but you remain in the tournament.
faq.swiss_intro: Play one game per round against an opponent near your current score.
faq.round_robin_end: The tournament finishes after every scheduled game has been resolved and the final standings can be calculated.
faq.round_robin_winner: Players are ranked by the configured game or match points. With 2, 4, or 6 games per opponent, all those games form one match. If scores are tied, the tournament's selected tiebreaks are applied in order.
faq.round_robin_availability: Depending on the tournament settings, games are available together or one at a time against each opponent.
faq.availability_question: When can I play my games?
faq.round_robin_pairing: The complete field is scheduled, so every player faces the same set of opponents.
faq.round_robin_intro: Every entrant plays every other entrant the configured number of times.
faq.arena_intro: Play as many games as you can before the Arena clock expires.
faq.swiss_winner: After the planned rounds, or earlier if no legal pairing remains, players are ranked by their standings score and then the tournament's tiebreaks.
faq.swiss_odd_field: One player receives the configured bye for that round and returns to the pairing pool next round.
faq.odd_field_question: What happens with an odd field?
faq.swiss_pairings: Players near the same score are paired while rematches are avoided whenever a legal pairing is available.
faq.release_sequential: The next game becomes available after the previous game is resolved.
faq.arena_fire_scoring: Win: 2 points. Draw: 1. Loss: 0. After two consecutive wins, a flame marks your double-point streak: wins earn 4 points and draws earn 2. The streak ends when you draw or lose.
faq.berserk_help: Berserk removes your increment and, when eligible, halves your starting time. A win earns {{bonus}} if the game lasts at least {{moves}} individual moves. Choose it before your first move.
faq.berserk_disabled: Berserk is disabled for this Arena.
faq.arena_pairing: Initial pairings use ratings. Later pairings use your tournament rank. Keep the Arena page open or return there for your next opponent.
faq.arena_end: Standings freeze when the countdown reaches zero. Finish any game still in progress; its result will not affect the standings.

rules_summary.single_elimination_bronze: Single elimination with a third-place match
rules_summary.match_availability: A match becomes available as soon as both players are known.
rules_summary.reset_final_help: If the lower-bracket winner wins the final, a second final determines the champion. Each final appears separately in the bracket.
rules_summary.round_robin_match_points: All {{games}} games against each opponent form one match. Compare the total game points to determine the match win, draw, or loss. Match points are awarded only after every game has a result, even if the match is already clinched. Partial and split forfeits count in the aggregate; if every game is a double forfeit, both players receive zero match points. Resting rounds award no points.
